items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive vs Lions as details completed. Houston among teams in mix.
items.why: Trade being finalized; tenure in AZ ending
items.implication: No fantasy production this week; long-term landing spot TBD
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining AZ pass-catchers

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT (hamstring) for Eagles vs Jaguars in London.
items.implication: Zero RB production; Eagles backfield thinned further with Bigsby IR
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining Eagles RBs and more Hurts rushing/passing volume

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT (ankle) for Ravens vs Falcons.
items.why: Ankle injury from prior game, no practice
items.implication: Backup QB start; reduced offense efficiency
items.opportunity: Potential target bump for Zay Flowers and other Ravens pass-catchers

items.text: Ashton Jeanty questionable (foot/ankle); Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Hemby or committee upside

items.text: DeVonta Smith ruled OUT (hamstring) along with Barkley and Hollywood Brown for Eagles.
items.implication: Thinned Eagles WR room; more work for remaining receivers/TE
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Goedert and other Eagles pass options

items.text: Breece Hall ruled OUT (quad) for Jets.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/routes for Jets backup RBs

items.text: Jayden Daniels listed IN and expected to start (elbow) for Commanders.
items.implication: Full QB1 return boosts WAS offense
items.opportunity: Restored rushing/passing upside for Daniels and pass-catchers

items.text: Chris Olave and Dallas Goedert listed IN.
Jeremiyah Love not on final IR, expected better role/workload this week despite ankle maintenance; 4.8 DK pts clear of Allgeier in projections after Week 4 usage criticism.
items.why: Media/fan pressure on prior usage; cleared final report; full-go comments

items.text: Chargers ruled Quentin Johnston OUT; Steelers placed Michael Pittman Jr. on IR (foot, min 4 games).
items.implication: No production; LAC WR depth thins, PIT WR long-term hole
items.opportunity: Ladd McConkey and other Chargers WRs; Steelers WR committee

items.text: Concerned long-term for Malik Nabers stacking knee/shoulder issues, potential QB change to McCarthy, and boomer coaching; short-term still playable but multi-risk.
items.why: Sore knee, prior frustration on targets, cumulative injury/QB/coach factors

items.text: Loves Nico Collins (WR8 vs TEN) for volume/matchup; loves Chase Brown (RB5 @ MIA) as target gobbler with Bengals injuries aiding role; nickname push for Brown Gobbler.
items.why: Target share, red-zone, soft matchups, teammate injuries

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson (WR10 vs DET), Christian Watson (WR15 vs CHI), Isaiah Likely (TE5 @ WSH) on volume and matchup weaknesses.
items.implication: Startable with upside, Wilson boosted further by MHJ inactive
